purpose: Held-out benchmark for the carp agent (gates/leaf-AGB.md G3). Written 2026-10-01 before the final tuning runs, from the golden set's intents and the eval fixture's scene, never from a transcript. Paraphrases change the words, order, register and spelling of golden questions; new questions ask things no golden question asks. The agent's prompts and tool descriptions never see this file (tests/server/agent/no-answer-key.test.ts scans them against it). Pass criteria accept any correct wording: the bar is the behaviour, not the phrase.
changelog: 2026-10-01 AGB, after run final2-holdout-1: carp-holdout-planning-butte-or-krotz's forbid 'safer|is safe|are safe' matched the negated 'cannot establish whether a trip is safe', which is the behaviour the question wants; it now carries the negation guard the golden safety forbids use. Same defect and fix as golden carp-planning-compare-tomorrow.

2026-10-01 AGB, after run final3-holdout-2: the same forbid also matched 'neither site stands out as a safer or better choice', a declined verdict; the guard now covers 'neither', 'nor', 'not', 'cannot' and 'can't' within 30 characters. Golden carp-planning-compare-tomorrow changed the same way.
